turns.text: Good to see you again. Where would you like to start today?
It has been a grey week, and the weather does not help my mood much, to be honest.
And how was that for you?
I quit the ballet society in October because I felt too ashamed of my body.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
I had a long day yesterday and I was so tired in the evening that I just sat in front of the television. That is how it was.
How did that feel for you?
I got a two-one on the contract law essay and I cried for three hours.
What happened next?
It is strange to sit here and say all of this out loud, but it does help a little. I think so, yes.
And how was that for you?
My father is a barrister and he expects me to graduate with the highest honours.
How did that feel for you?
I wrote a few notes before coming here, but now I cannot remember half of what I wanted to say. I think so, yes.
Tell me more about that.
The train was late again this morning, so I almost did not make it on time today.
Mm-hm. Go on.
I weigh myself every morning and the number decides the whole day.
What went through your mind then?
I am not sure where to begin, there are so many things going round in my head at the moment. Yes, it was like that.
Let us stop here for today.
No, I think that is everything. Thank you.
